fieldValues.title: A third-party repository became readable with today's tools: ranked root, anchored sections, reading views, a front-door document
fieldValues.summary: LiveWyer Insight (2026-10-30) went from an empty first screen and a flat list to a ranked, nested, labelled reading in srs-web without new features. It shows which human-readability practices work now and which need the core.
evidence: ~/dev/livewyer-insight commit fe4443b: root lists opportunities ranked by signal, then The evidence; each opportunity anchors a container of problems, each problem a container of findings
Reading guide in the identity purpose record, rendered first in the default document
displayLabel on every field, a *-card view per type (titleFieldId heading, labelMode none, machine fields hidden)
Four compositions; srs-web opens compositions[0], so the signal map was installed first (front door by convention only)
Still broken by tools: srs-rust#1490 (navigation order), srs-web#668 (container pane ignores the outline), srs-web#425 (no third nav level), srs#911 (H1 to H3), srs#928 (no composition title)
fieldValues.body: Gathered for the human-readable repositories research thread. The practices match the owner's 2026-10-26 discussion (vignettes 29d4cbd4, ac5974c6): a few purpose-shaped areas at the top, never a data dump. Problem containers restating evidences edges as membership is a cost of the missing relation selection (finding bbe2be46).
